NBA.p5_policy: Basketball-Reference operational reconciliation; ESPN cross-check; NBA.com official discrepancy verification; SportsDataverse structured enrichment
NBA.assessment: No recurring user upload should be necessary, but CURRENT docs do not pin one canonical machine-download endpoint/artifact for the weekly structured refresh.

NHL.p5_policy: SportsDataverse fastRhockey pipeline for schedules/rosters/boxscores/PBP/scratches/shifts; Hockey-Reference reconciliation; ESPN cross-check; NHL.com official verification
NHL.assessment: Suitable for the same persistent-fetch pattern once exact current artifact URLs are pinned.

Soccer.p5_policy: ESPN Soccer Scoreboard by CURRENT league/date; official competition site for discrepancies
Soccer.assessment: HTTP/date-window adapter is feasible; exact endpoint/schema and official discrepancy routing must be frozen before calling it automatic.

Tennis.p5_policy: ATP Tour official results archive/current tournament results; WTA official tournament scores/matches; Flashscore cross-check
Tennis.assessment: Dynamic tournament discovery/identity makes this unsuitable for a simple recurring file fetch. It should still be automated, but with a dedicated ATP/WTA discovery + parser adapter rather than weekly uploads.
